{"type":"thought","data":" 11 cites 37.8%. An "}
{"type":"thought","data":"October 5 article claims"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 38.5%, conflicting "}
{"type":"thought","data":"with an earlier October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2 tweet at 38.3%.\n\n"}
{"type":"thought","data":"The article sidebar "}
{"type":"thought","data":"shows 37.8% / 60.0%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely reflecting a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" live widget as of the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" crawl."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe sidebar's 37.8%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" figure is likely the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" live widget value as"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of October 13, not "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the October 5 article's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stated 38.5%. This "}
{"type":"thought","data":"creates a clear conflict:"}

{"type":"thought","data":" all show 38.1%, while"}

{"type":"thought","data":" and the sidebar both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" cite 37.8%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe sidebar's 37.8%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" approval, 60.0% disapproval,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and -22.2% spread match"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the October 11 tweet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exactly. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the sidebar reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 11 data rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than a live widget."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Kalshi and MacroMicro"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both confirm 38.1% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"on October 12."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe resolution date"}

{"type":"thought","data":" ET. The current 38.1%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" approval sits 0.3 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above the 37.8% threshold."}

{"type":"thought","data":" at 34, AP/NORC at 31,"}

{"type":"thought","data":"Checking Kalshi data"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for the Trump approval"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rating market."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nKalshi resolved the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market at 38.1% on "}
{"type":"thought","data":"October 12, well above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 37.8% threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The October 10 reading"}
{"type":"thought","data":" was 37.8%, but the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"figure rose to 38.1%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by the 1 PM ET close."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMacroMicro also shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 38.10% on October 12,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" up from 38.00%. A cached"}
{"type":"thought","data":" RCP page lists a 9/21–10/11"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average of 38.1, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" aligns with the Kalshi"}
{"type":"thought","data":" close. The sidebar "}
{"type":"thought","data":"widget still displays"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the October 10–11 reading"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 37.8, suggesting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it may be stale."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe sidebar figure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is likely stale from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 10–11. Rasmussen"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls remain unchanged"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 41/58. I need to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fetch the current October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 13 RCP average, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the site is JavaScript-rendered"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and may require a browser"}
{"type":"thought","data":" user agent or API."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market closes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 5 PM ET, four hours"}
{"type":"thought","data":" after Kalshi’s 1 PM"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ET resolution. RCP "}
{"type":"thought","data":"averages rarely shift"}
{"type":"thought","data":" within hours unless"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a new poll is added."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA timeline of recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" readings shows the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"figure climbed from "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly 38.2% on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2 to 38.5% on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 5, then dropped to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"37.8% on October 10 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and 11, before rising"}
{"type":"thought","data":" again to 38.1% by October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12.\n\nI will also search"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a JSON endpoint"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or recent tweets to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" verify the current "}
{"type":"thought","data":"October 13 average.\n\nThe 0.3-point rebound"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from October 10 to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"October 12 likely came"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from a Morning Consult"}
{"type":"thought","data":" poll dated October "}
{"type":"thought","data":"9–11 at 42%. RCP typically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" averages the most recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" poll from each pollster"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than all listed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am manually summing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 14 pollster figures"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from the RCP table "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to verify the average."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The running total has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reached 280."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe manual calculation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirms the 14 pollster"}
{"type":"thought","data":" figures average to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"38.1. The earlier 37.8"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reading from October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 11 likely used a different"}
{"type":"thought","data":" set of polls, since"}
{"type":"thought","data":" twelve polls at 37.8"}
{"type":"thought","data":" equal 453.6 total points."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 14-poll average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 38.1 is confirmed."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The current window "}
{"type":"thought","data":"spans 20 days, with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Emerson polls from September"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 21–22 as the oldest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" entry. Polls older "}
{"type":"thought","data":"than this window are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dropped."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSimulating the RCP"}
{"type":"thought","data":" window shift by October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 16. If the newest poll"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ends around October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 15, older polls like"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Emerson, Quinnipiac,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and AP/NORC would drop"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from the average. Removing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" those three low polls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would raise the average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to roughly 39.1%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRCP does not simply"}
{"type":"thought","data":" drop polls without "}
{"type":"thought","data":"adding new ones, so "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the window shift may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not be as mechanical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as assumed. New polls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" released between October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 13 and 16 could replace"}
{"type":"thought","data":" older entries instead."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRasmussen has been"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stable at 41% since"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 5. Morning "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Consult’s latest poll"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 42% from October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 9–11, with a prior "}
{"type":"thought","data":"41% reading from October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 4–5. The next Morning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Consult release is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"expected mid-week."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEconomist/YouGov and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Reuters/Ipsos polls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are also due for release."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A new YouGov poll would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely land near 36–38%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" replacing the current"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 38% entry with little"}
{"type":"thought","data":" impact on the average."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A fresh Reuters poll"}
{"type":"thought","data":" could drop the figure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly if it lands"}
{"type":"thought","data":" around 32–36%. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"earlier 35% reading "}
{"type":"thought","data":"from AOL probably reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a different crosstab."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.3-point cushion"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above the threshold"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is a real buffer, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a drop to 37.7 or lower"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would still resolve"}
{"type":"thought","data":" NO. That would require"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a roughly 0.4-point"}
{"type":"thought","data":" decline over four days."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Less frequent pollsters"}
{"type":"thought","data":" like CBS and Pew are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" unlikely to update "}
{"type":"thought","data":"in time. The average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has been sticky, yet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a downward move remains"}
{"type":"thought","data":" possible."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe net change from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 5 to October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12 is a 0.4-point decline."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A continuation of the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" early October downtrend"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at roughly 0.1 point"}
{"type":"thought","data":" per day would push "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the figure to 37.7 by"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 16, resolving"}
{"type":"thought","data":" NO. If the average "}
{"type":"thought","data":"stays rangebound between"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 37.8 and 38.3, YES is more likely.\n\nThe market price of 0.590 for Yes suggests the benchmark expects YES, but this bench market shows wide bid-ask spreads with no trade history, so the price may not reflect true consensus."}
